en: Black‑and‑white landscape view of a river or lake with small rowing boats and a covered wooden pier or boathouse with flagpoles. On the far bank stands a lush tree line, behind which are several late‑19th‑century villas and townhouses. On a hill to the right rises a large Gothic‑revival church with a tall spire. The scene is framed like a classic tourist view of a small European town by the water.
